lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Su Hai is ill. She goes to see the doctor.
lines.chinese: 苏海生病了。她去看医生。

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: I have a headache. I feel cold.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.english: Let me check. You have a fever.
lines.chinese: 让我检查一下。你发烧了。

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.english: You should have a rest at home. You should take some medicine and drink some warm water.
lines.chinese: 你应该在家休息。你应该吃点药，喝点温水。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Mike has a toothache. He goes to see the dentist.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.english: I have a toothache. I can't eat anything!
lines.chinese: 我牙疼。我什么都吃不了！

lines.speaker: Dentist
lines.english: Do you eat a lot of sweets?

lines.speaker: Dentist
lines.english: You shouldn't eat too many sweets. You should brush your teeth in the morning and before bedtime.
lines.chinese: 你不应该吃太多糖果。你应该在早上和睡前刷牙。
